component-o.description-s: PCB fuse clip for 5 mm diameter (5x20 mm) cartridge fuses, 100 056 series, spring brass, tin-plated, 10 A max; filed as the clip PAIR that holds one fuse (BOM quantity 2 per fuse)

source-o.table-s: Product Characteristics: 100 054/056 series, 5 mm diameter fuses (213 ... 977 series), current level 10 A max; Ordering Information: 01000056Z, 100 056, spring brass, tin-plated, ear style; p2 Recommended Mounting Dimensions: A 20.5 mm for 5x20, B 4.60 +/- 0.05 mm (100 series), holes 1.30 +0.10/-0.00 mm

not_stated-o.contact_mohm: the clip datasheet gives no contact resistance
not_stated-o.voltage_max_mv: the clip datasheet gives no voltage rating (UL file E14721 only)

component-o.pin_roles_note-s: pin roles: a fuse (and its holder) is non-polar; pin 1 = supply side (ds-power-rx) and pin 2 = load side (ds-power-tx) is a convention only, as on the DSK310 series diode; either orientation is electrically the same
component-o.supply_pins_are_pass_note-s: a fuse holder (clip pair) in the power path: its pins are the two contacts the fuse seats in, with no operating supply range of their own; the holder ratings in fuse_holder-o (10 A) are the figures the checks use

provenance-o.basis-s: procurement public-check: every document in the record folder has a public http(s) source; nothing confidential, no correspondence or quote data, no person named outside non-technical-o, not an NDA part; footprint and 3D model of recorded public origin
